menu_items_target_ref.name: menu_items_target_ref
menu_items_target_ref.value:
("menu_items"."target" <> 'category' or "menu_items"."category_id" is not null)
        and ("menu_items"."target" <> 'page' or "menu_items"."page_id" is not null)
        and ("menu_items"."target" <> 'url' or "menu_items"."url" is not null)

services_price_amount.name: services_price_amount
services_price_amount.value:
("services"."price_kind" = 'on_request' and "services"."price_amount" is null)
        or ("services"."price_kind" <> 'on_request' and "services"."price_amount" is not null and "services"."price_amount" >= 0)
